r: <!-- This computer (per-machine, localStorage only — never written to KV) -->

Suggested replies

Every suggested reply is one sentence about the conversation, then: “Let’s discuss this further. My calendar is at <this link>”.

<script>
// v5.12.0 — calendar link for Suggested replies, editable in Settings (stored in /api/knowledge).
(function () {
  async function calLoad() {
    try {
      var r = await fetch(window.location.origin + '/api/knowledge');
      if (!r.ok) return;
      var kb = (await r.json()).kb || {};
      var el = document.getElementById('set-calendarLink');
      if (el && !el.value) el.value = kb.calendarLink || '';
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  window.calSave = async function () {
    var el = document.getElementById('set-calendarLink');
    var hint = document.getElementById('cal-hint');
    hint.textContent = 'Saving…';
    try {
      var r = await fetch(window.location.origin + '/api/knowledge');
      var kb = r.ok ? ((await r.json()).kb || {}) : {};
      kb.calendarLink = el.value.trim();
      var res = await fetch(window.location.origin + '/api/knowledge', { method: 'PUT', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ kb: kb }) });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
      var saved = (await res.json()).kb || {};
      el.value = saved.calendarLink || '';
      var other = document.getElementById('kb-calendarLink');
      if (other) other.value = el.value;
      if (typeof suggState !== 'undefined') suggState = {};
      hint.textContent = 'Saved. New suggested replies will use it.';
    } catch (e) { hint.textContent = 'Could not save: ' + e.message; }
  };
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', calLoad); else calLoad();
})();
</script>
</body>
